string.text: Writes a named manual save (safety_save) while out of combat. Always after the max interval, or after the min cooldown when you open inventory, heal to 100%, eat, or drink. Timers are this load only.
If this many minutes have passed since the last safety_save and you are not in combat, save anyway. 0 = off.
Minimum minutes since the last safety_save before opening inventory, healing to 100%, eating, or drinking can trigger a save.
